EchoMemory - Remembering Those Who Left
"Death is not the end; forgetting is." 
"As long as you remember, he/she is still here." 
EchoMemory is an AI Skill project based on the OpenClaw/Claude Code. It enables you to transform the beloved ones who have passed away - whether they are deceased relatives, distant friends, or important people you have lost contact with - into a conversational AI Skill. 
By importing chat records, photos, videos, voice messages and text descriptions, we can recreate ta's personality, speaking style and emotional expression, allowing ta to continue existing in your life in another form.
